notes.title: Next stop Skalka! Devlog
notes.notes:
[p][b]Most of you have already thoroughly tested the new 81-71 trainset.[/b]
The new online leaderboard clearly shows how many successful stops some players have already achieved — hats off! That’s what we call passion and precision! We definitely didn’t expect such high scores.[/p][p][b]You might be wondering what's next?[/b]
You’ll find out in this post. Let us give you a [b]sneak peek into the development[/b] of the next version!

[b]Next station: Skalka![/b][/p][p]The next route expansion will, of course, include the section to Skalka. Our amazing modeler Honza is already finalizing the models of Strašnická and Skalka stations. For the first time since version one, we’ll return to shallow-built stations like Dejvická. And no wonder — we’re gradually heading above ground![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/6c79833bf686249dfd385da47dbecd2bc9be706d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/48ceb31454df514d4db8d07689ddc5ac73fb4a02.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]Hurá do depa![/h1][p][/p][p][b]Into the Depot![/b][/p][p]Above ground, we’re preparing the long-awaited Hostivař depot.[/p][p]This is a large-scale project involving much of the team.
At the moment, we’re working on terrain and the many models needed for the area.[/p][quote][p]“Work on Hostivař is in full swing, currently in the phase of preparing 3D models and terrain. The hardest part is gathering and interpreting references – carefully analyzing available resources and transforming real objects into precise, technically accurate, and visually believable 3D models.[/p][p]We’re handling this with great care – environmental authenticity and attention to detail are our priorities. When estimating dimensions from photographs, we use perspective-reconstruction software that helps us approximate real-world measurements, even when technical blueprints are missing.[/p][p]The biggest challenge is the depot itself, which, due to its size, must be split into modular sections. Special attention is also given to its interior – it’s a complex space, and getting it right is key to creating a strong impression as players arrive.[/p][p]At the same time, we're always thinking about optimization. Our goal is the most efficient topology possible, ensuring smooth gameplay without sacrificing detail.[/p][p]For terrain creation, we use publicly available elevation and 3D map data, but since these often lack the needed precision, most of the area is manually adjusted and completed. The challenge is to design the surroundings to look natural from afar while also leaving room for future map expansions. The terrain is therefore shaped with visibility, navigation, and future connections in mind.”[/p][/quote][p]— Matěj Emmer, depo Hostivař Project Lead[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/27e3095ae01d7d18545dfe050258b2f41ae1aa7f.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/aadf415a0007d15f9d745b90d8919b8e3474a41d.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/4e9528a08aa621fc64905ececf059da1bf14b705.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/ddcc653a3b75faf59fce3cd1817dae7950bd19e6.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/92378ac8027d41cc3ca57adeb427c1dd01869ff9.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/59445ce98c7e321f1ebf2a9eead54c1302174531.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/a81ba3add1534706a292c8b52bbc18e55fb65aa9.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/5f6fedf78c6838b05613defe0c32740b9421535c.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/b8b245a588dacc77caf9be0b91d6fa065f0d2c85.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p]Wicro:[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/913b1d75adf34ca9787fb9c25479ae72a1b6f15e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/13a8f5d3c53dd215ea0369c9be48aa98879bef4e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/08469dca0f5dfe27a4204cc0a923b00146068597.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]Thank you for following our development! We have many more exciting updates ahead.[/p][p]— On behalf of the BiS team,
Dominik Vojta[/p]

notes.title: The update with the new trainset is out!
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your patience and support – we’ve just released one of the most anticipated updates! What’s new?

We’ve added one of the most requested features to the game – the legendary 81-71 trainset, bringing a completely new driving experience. Along with it comes a more realistic control mode, perfect for fans of precision and authentic procedures. Both historical trainsets, EČS and 81-71, now feature an interactive cab, allowing you to control most elements directly, including newly implemented functional compressors and a wide range of new sounds that enhance the immersive feeling of sitting in the driver’s seat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/4be78a3de4fa7685461ba90a17c3a643a32f14a3.jpg[/img]

A new addition is the stop accuracy rating, giving you feedback on your performance and helping you fine-tune your driving to perfection. If you enjoy competition, you’ll love the new global leaderboard for the most accurate drivers – compare your results with players around the world. We’ve also added achievements to reward your skill and dedication.

And last but not least – this update fixes many previously reported bugs, so the game will run smoother than ever before. Thank you for your continued support, and we look forward to your feedback!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/a9187905eda7012f82ce0a5386bfd4a194bbbbd4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/0a443058213be48d58fc09a0e188503abe3ba204.jpg[/img]

Highlights:

Legendary 81-71 trainset

More realistic control mode

Interactive cab for EČS and 81-71

Functional compressors

Many new sounds

Stop accuracy rating

Global leaderboard

Achievements

Numerous bug fixes

notes.title: New train is coming tomorrow!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/0dc4a7a7bc267f33217a7f5b573ce8543afb96fa.jpg[/img]

The 81-71 metro train became an icon of the Prague underground and an integral part of its history. It was first put into operation on May 1, 1978, on Line C and was gradually introduced on other lines as well, replacing the older EČS type.

Over more than three decades, these trains transported millions of passengers and became a symbol of everyday life in the capital. Due to their distinctive appearance, they earned the nickname "black muzzle."

The gradual phase-out began in 2003 and was completed on July 2, 2009, when the 81-71 trains made their final regular service run.

Although their era has ended, one five-car set has been preserved as a historical unit and occasionally appears during special events. The 81-71 train remains in the memory of many Prague residents as an important part of the city’s public transport history.

[h3][b]Our game brings this train back into service — and this time, you're the driver![/b][/h3]

notes.title: Big Update is Out! 🚇🆕
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/e50dd234f399ab97c95f70fceebbac891a535c0d.jpg[/img]

We have great news for all fans of our game! A new update is here, bringing lots of improvements and new content. What’s waiting for you?

🔹 New Passengers – Completely reworked models of all passengers, who can finally sit down! Your trains will now feel even more realistic and lively.

🔹 New Stations – We’re expanding the playable section to include Jiřího z Poděbrad, Flora, and Želivského stations. There’s also a new turning point beyond Želivského.

🔹 Flexible Routes – You’ll now be able to choose between longer and shorter routes, so you can tailor the game to how much time you have for driving.

🔹 New Challenges – Can you handle the Bucket Challenge?

🔹 Authentic Announcements – In collaboration with Mrs. Lavičková herself, we’ve prepared brand-new announcements that will enhance the metro atmosphere even further!

🔹 New unlockable EČS improvement - insert your Timetable directly into the cabin.

🔹 Many Bug Fixes

This update is another step toward expanding and improving the game – thank you for your support, and we’re excited to hear your feedback! 🚆💨

(We are sorry, Mac OS version will be a little delayed due to techincal complications.)

Hello to all metro enthusiasts and fans of our game!

We've been working on a new version for some time now. Today, we'll show you what you can look forward to!

[h2][b]NEW SECTION OF LINE A[/b][/h2]

The long-awaited extension of Line A is almost complete. Take a look at some screenshots from the new version.

[h2][b]NEW NPCs[/b][/h2]

Passengers in the game have undergone a complete overhaul. They now have a much more realistic appearance and greater variety. Their behavior has also changed. They can sit down, and inside the train, they logically stand only in available spaces. All of this comes without any impact on performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/3b2005e28bb07e11ef51cd3f5b0b3cd2252e6538.jpg[/img]

The new section is being programmed to allow players to choose whether they want to take a shorter route from DE to NM or a longer one from Dejvická to Želivského. The train announcements and rewards for the ride will adjust accordingly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/0a8bb1253fabffa223c1d12bedf38509dc9fea2d.png[/img]

[h2][b]NEW ANNOUNCEMENTS[/b][/h2]
We have managed to establish a collaboration with the amazing radio host, editor, and reporter, Mrs. Světlana Lavičková. Her voice has been guiding passengers in the Prague metro since 1978, and now she will be heard in our game as well. This will further enhance the authentic gameplay experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/e422874bbbb828c6f48adc5313a6a67148d74966.png[/img]


Of course, this update will also bring many bug fixes and some suprises.


Thank you for following our progress!

notes.title: What are we working on? ROADMAP
notes.notes:
The launch of our game on Steam is approaching very quickly. Let’s take a look at what’s ahead and what we’re currently working on.

[h2]New Stations[/h2]
We’re currently focusing on [b]extending the line[/b] to Želivského. All the stations are already modeled and textured. Now we need to do a lot of programming, build tracks, tunnels, turning points, and implement everything into the game. We’ll gradually showcase all the stations. Let’s start with [b]Jiřího z Poděbrad[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/018dad6ae4acc47fbe2a55b99f357629a716dca7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/45daf87948bd714977cdace616c6c25d2c8ac320.jpg[/img]

[h2]Hostivař Depot[/h2]
Hostivař Depot will be a big project, so we’re working on it gradually whenever possible. At the moment, we’re focusing on the [b]track layout[/b] and track construction. As you can see in the picture, it’s quite a challenge. :-)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/51caf6132e3a041fcc3b699f6d972e6d45f174bd.jpg[/img]

[h2]Procedural Switches[/h2]
While working on the depot track network, we realized we needed to speed up the creation of switches. Until now, we’ve been making each one manually, which is very time-consuming. Our programmer, Space Worthy, started working on procedural switches, and the results are fantastic. Creating a switch now takes just a few minutes, and the quality is perfect! This is currently helping us significantly with the line extension.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/cf01300cd1d8666888429b7ffff8158b6f291761.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/cd06822b58ad22bf5b20645a0a2e7c4913ca7172.jpg[/img]

[h2]81-71[/h2]
Yes, work on the long-awaited 81-71 trainset is progressing according to plan. We’re fine-tuning the last details on the model and will then start programming. We’ll gradually share more details. Since many of you have already found Jarda, you can see him here taking a test run with Doubravec.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/fe316b12d7246b5ea82a8b82658b9760c7dfa07f.jpg[/img]

[h2]Sounds[/h2]
Not only does the mentioned 81-71 need sounds, but the EČS also deserves an audio upgrade.
We’re very grateful to the Prague Public Transit Company for allowing us to record new sounds for the game.
We can already say that this will be a big improvement, significantly enhancing the authentic driving experience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/dd356d173895ab7cea9c7e4649a6ce31b3797ee6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/83fa363e92a771f274f8438ec733bb27092928b0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/d092ed6ed272038b516d5ff7c45d413d359abdb9.jpg[/img]

[h3]As you can see, there’s still a lot of work to be done, but it will be worth it![/h3]
We kindly ask you to [b]be patient[/b]. We don’t want to rush anything, and each of these steps requires dozens or even hundreds of hours. We’re all excited about the result.
Thanks to your contributions, this is possible, and work is progressing at this pace.
[h3]Thank you very much![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321274/c350206c5b57a7f70fe1b5bd90da12f98ffacdcc.png[/img]
